classification_policy.blur: background row with exact log SwapSuccess=False, embedding failure, non-GOOD quality, or fallback reasons -> BLUR when fallback blur is enabled
classification_policy.swap: background row with exact frame/track log SwapSuccess=True -> SWAP
classification_policy.unknown: background GOOD rows without per-track swap log evidence -> UNKNOWN
classification_policy.unprocessed: the same rows -> UNPROCESSED when fallback blur is disabled

notes: Current VEIL face metadata does not contain a final action or swap_success field.
SWAP is therefore under-counted to logged frame/track evidence; UNKNOWN is intentionally conservative.
